Alternatives

A Countdown Star alternative without ads

Countdown Star is a long-running countdown app with more than 216,000 ratings. Its free version shows ads, and the ad-free version is a separate $1.99 app. If you want a free countdown app without ads, here's how Simple Count compares.

Facts about the other app come from its own US App Store listing, checked on 17 October 2026. We make Simple Count, so read this with that in mind; tap through to the App Store before you buy. See all apps side by side on our comparison page.

Where Countdown Star is better

It has an Apple Watch app, time zone support for each event, celebration animations and a long track record.

Where Simple Count is better

No ads in the free app, a privacy label of "Data Not Collected", Lock Screen widgets and a Live Activity for timed events, shared countdowns that stay in sync for everyone, and notes with checklists, all free.

Questions

Is there a free countdown app without ads?

Yes. Simple Count is free with no ads and no subscription, and every widget is included. Pro is an optional one-time purchase.
